info.title: Tabyldy API
info.description: Lost & found platform — public mobile API and admin API. Errors are `{code, message, status, requestId}` with localized messages (Accept-Language: ru|ky).

devCode.description: Present only in development when OTP_DEV_ECHO=true

guestRefreshToken.description: Refresh token of the guest account on this device. Its listings, claims and chats are kept: the guest becomes a verified account or is merged into the existing one.

notificationPrefs.description: Map of optional notification type → enabled

amount.description: Amount in KGS; the platform never holds or transfers money.

approximateLocationId.description: Approximate district / city id. Exact coordinates are never accepted.

hiddenFeatures.description: Hidden verification features — never shown publicly.

contactPhone.description: Contact phone. Private: shown only to the owner and to a claimant whose claim was approved.

aiAssisted.description: True when AI suggestions were used to pre-fill fields.

publish.description: False keeps the item as a server-side draft.

acceptRules.description: Must be true to publish: user accepted publication rules.

contactPhone.description: Contact phone. Private: shown only to the owner and to a claimant whose claim was approved.

resolution.description: resolved = item returned / found; closed = no longer relevant

mediaId.description: Media id uploaded via /media (stored in the protected contour).

message.description: Short message to the other party. No secrets here.

contact.description: How to answer: phone, email or Telegram (optional).

note.description: Sent to the owner as "needs fix" when status is PENDING_REVIEW/REMOVED
